title: fix(plugin-audit): a member removes their own comment reaction through an own-row unreact door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQxK8SxQ94Ud3phjAvzrrEE)_

Fixes #26161

This is the server half of ruling 6422861164 (letter A). The console half (the reaction chip calls the new route, and `feedReactionRemove` stops reading a `delete` grant) is a separate `domain:ui` card that the seat files with `Blocked-by: #26161`.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

`AuditPlugin` mounts an own-row unreact door on the kernel's HTTP server:

| | |
|---|---|
| Method and path | `DELETE /api/v1/comments/reactions/:id` (`:id` is the `sys_comment_reaction` row id) |
| Body | none read; any query parameter is refused |
| `200` | `{ success: true, data: { id, deleted: true } }` |
| `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` | a query parameter, or an empty id |
| `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` | the request names nobody |
| `403` held-sign-in code | an expired password or MFA not yet enrolled (the auth policy's own code) |
| `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` | the row is another member's reaction; it stays |
| `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | no such row, or a row the caller cannot read (same answer, so nothing leaks) |
| `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | the permission store cannot be read, or no data engine is registered |

How it decides, in order:

1. The caller is resolved by the platform's one request-to-context composition, `resolveRequestExecutionContext`, with the settings door's choices: fail-closed for anonymous, the sign-in gate resolved onto the context, API key and session both admitted, nothing localized, no bearer carried.
2. Anonymous, held sign-in and query-parameter refusals come next.
3. The row is read **as the caller**, so the object grant, the organization wall and the reaction read gate (a reaction is readable exactly when its comment is) all decide. A row the caller cannot read answers the same `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` as an unknown id. That is the answer the data door gives both.
4. The row's `created_by` must be the caller. This is the column the platform's own-record floor (`owner_only_deletes`) reads, stamped by the engine with the reactor. Otherwise the door answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`.
5. Only then is the row removed by id, under a system context with `attributedUserId` set to the caller and the caller's `tenantId`. Step 4 is the only way in to that elevated write. If the driver reports that nothing matched (a race), the door answers `404`.

What does not move: no permission set gains `delete`, `member_default` (`default-permission-sets.ts`) is untouched, and `security-anchor-high-privilege` (ADR-0090 D5) is untouched. The generic `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction/:id` answers exactly what it did before.

Files:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-reaction-routes.ts`: the door, `removeOwnCommentReaction`, and `platformCallerResolver`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`: `start()` mounts the door on `http.server` (falling back to the `http-server` alias). With no HTTP server it warns once and mounts nothing.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-reaction-route-ledger.ts` plus its `.conformance.test.ts`: the package-local route ledger, using the print-door model. The row is a `gap` because `@objectstack/client` has no method yet.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment-reaction.object.ts`: the header's Delete section now names the door.
- `scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs`: lists the door as a delegator of `resolveRequestExecutionContext`, so a later re-inline of the resolver goes red.
- `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`: the census regenerated for the door's one system-context write (243→244 sites).
- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`: declares the new `*-routes.ts` module with `{ responses: 0, ok: 0, err: 0 }`. Every body goes through the shared `sendOk` / `sendError` / `sendServerFault`.
- `.changeset/26161-own-row-unreact-door.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-audit`.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/comment-reaction-unreact-door.integration.test.ts` runs on the real kernel, the real `SecurityPlugin` with the shipped sets, and the real `AuditPlugin` (object, read gate and mounted door). Caller resolution is real too: the platform resolver runs over seeded `sys_user` / `sys_member` rows and an auth service whose session read names the user. The member is a plain organization member with no position. Their baseline is `member_default` composed with an app every-member set that grants read and create (never delete) on comments and reactions. Cases:
  - own row: `200`, and the row is gone on read-back;
  - foreign row: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, and the row stays;
  - a reaction on a comment the caller cannot read: `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, the same status and code as an unknown id, and the row stays;
  - unknown id: `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`;
  - anonymous: `401`; a query parameter: `400`. In both cases the row stays;
  - the generic data-door delete of the member's own row still answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, via the engine delete under the caller plus `mapDataError`, the data door's own path. The row stays.

  The test lives in plugin-security because plugin-security already has a devDependency on plugin-audit. The reverse edge would be a workspace cycle.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-reaction-routes.test.ts`: the door's shell before the engine is asked (permission store outage `503`, nobody `401`, held sign-in `403`, no engine `503`, engine fault `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`), plus the `AuditPlugin` mount with and without an HTTP server.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-reaction-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: checks ledger and registrar in both directions.

Red first, on base `c4968860` with the door not mounted: 6 of 8 integration cases red, each with "no DELETE /api/v1/comments/reactions/:id is mounted". The fixture case and the generic-delete `403` case were green, which is the defect itself.

Ablation of the reactor check, on `0f28b47607` (`if (row.created_by !== callerId) throw …` deleted through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): plugin-audit was rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` reported the marker absent from all 6 dist files. Then 1 failed and 7 passed, and the failure was the foreign-row case alone. Restore: HEAD blob hash matched, the rebuild had the marker present in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`, the tree was clean, and the run was 8 of 8.

Package runs on `0f28b47607`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` passed 64 files and 1023 tests. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test` passed 229 files, with 4942 passing and 45 skipped. The `--project repo` suites of core, objectql, rest, runtime, spec and types all passed. `typecheck` exited 0 for both. eslint `--no-inline-config` on both packages exited 0.

Gates on `0f28b47607`: all 122 commands `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff exited 0, and `--ran` reconciled 122 derived, 122 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- The route is a `gap` on the SDK: `@objectstack/client` has no method for it. The console reaches the server through `ObjectStackClient` (`ui/packages/data-objectstack`), so the console half will want a client method or a direct call. That half is the seat's `domain:ui` card.
- The dogfood live-mount parity gate (`route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`) boots the showcase without `AuditPlugin`, so this ledger is not in its union, and this route is neither probed nor flagged there. The package-local conformance test is this route's guard. Adding `AuditPlugin` to that boot is outside this card.
- An impersonation session may use the door, as it may use the generic data door to add a reaction. The removal is attributed to the session's user.
